description: Reference catalog of Replit-supported MCP servers and their activation patterns

servers.name: PluginMesh Broker
servers.description: Plugin catalog broker for Codex. Routes goals to plugins, generates manifest templates, and surfaces ecosystem payloads.

servers.name: Alloy MCP Server
servers.description: SZL Holdings Alloy orchestration server. Exposes workflow, skill, decision, and connector tools over HTTP JSON-RPC.

servers.name: GitHub MCP Server
servers.description: Official GitHub MCP server. Provides repository, issue, PR, and Actions tools.

servers.name: Filesystem MCP Server
servers.description: Official MCP filesystem server. Provides read, write, list, and search tools scoped to the workspace.

servers.name: Postgres MCP Server
servers.description: Official MCP PostgreSQL server. Provides query, schema inspection, and transaction tools.

servers.name: Brave Search MCP
servers.description: Brave Search MCP server. Privacy-preserving web search with structured results.

servers.name: Slack MCP Server
servers.description: Slack MCP server for messaging, channel history, and workspace search.

servers.name: Sequential Thinking MCP
servers.description: Structured multi-step reasoning server. Helps AI models break down complex problems into verifiable steps.
